name: Free Shadcn UI Blocks
summary: Free shadcn/ui marketing blocks for React and Tailwind: the repo ships 55, the site lists 113+, installed with the shadcn CLI.

Copy-paste or install with the official shadcn CLI; built with Tailwind 4 and React.
